title: I had Claude build me an entire games platform + 11 games + user accounts + leaderboards + multiplayer in a week. Everything with Opus 4.6.
author: ledniv

comments.author: anaveragebest
comments.body: How's that working out since I only see a link? Is it profitable, do people like the games?

replies.author: ledniv
replies.body:
Well I only just made it and there is no monetization yet. Literally only posted about it here and LinkedIn.

For now it is more about exploring what Claude can do. But I do plan on adding a central currency (like VBucks / Robux) and letting others deploy their own games from Claude. More to see if it can be done.

comments.author: PuteMorte
comments.body: That's pretty cool. Only played a couple, but I think the jumping soccer one is a good concept. Games lack depth a bit, of course, but it's certainly something entertaining enough to burn an hour or two.
